listing.name: Elf Bowling / Elf Bowling Recomp
listing.summary: Bowl with your own copy of the original 1999 Elf Bowling executable.

steps.title: Choose the upstream player
steps.instruction: On Linux x64 with glibc 2.38 or later, use the v1.1 AppImage. Set PORT_FULLSCREEN=0 to start in a window. For Windows x64, choose v1.0 in the release picker, extract the full ZIP, and run elfbowl.exe with its bundled libraries.

steps.title: Select the unmodified original
steps.instruction: Use your own 1,130,496-byte Elf Bowling.exe from the 1999 release. Pick it on first run, put it next to the player, or point ELFBOWL_EXE to it on desktop. The upstream player checks SHA-256 and keeps a copy in its app profile. Keep your original separately.

steps.title: Use the separate Android or Mac setup
steps.instruction: The v1.0 release has an Android APK for ARM64 and x64. It uses Android’s file picker for the original. The upstream Mac instructions build from source with SDL2 and SDL2_ttf. The publisher supplies no Mac or Linux ARM64 package.

steps.title: Keep the app profile
steps.instruction: Preserve the NStorm/Elf Bowling profile before replacing the upstream player. It is normally under XDG_DATA_HOME or ~/.local/share on Linux, and under %APPDATA% on Windows. Android keeps its app files separately. Keep any optional locally generated artwork with the copy that uses it.

warnings: The project has not published a license for its engine source. The original game is supplied separately.
